float_layout: IEEE binary32 triplets and row-major 3x3; authored controls retain their recorded binary32/binary64 encodings.
comparison_policy: Exact finite/zero bits and infinity signs; NaN classification for exceptional unsanitized leaf observations. Complete products, flags/tags and hashes remain exact. No epsilon.

adoption.review_scope: Narrow authority mapping for the new matrix producer; implementation review and acceptance remain separate.

reference_roles.matrices[*].xyz_to_linear_srgb_and_unrea: Original native characterization. Windows Release contains B; these are not expected results for the new producer/default. Captured bytes are retained.
reference_roles.conversion[*].xyz_to_linear_srgb_and_exp: Exact explicit operands and outputs. Windows Release B operands must be consumed unchanged, never reselected from input_matrices.
reference_roles.other_records: All decoder, linear, projection, helper and completed-product requirements remain exact with the stated NaN classification.

settings: 96 base products: Portra negative / Provia positive x direct/Endura print x four input tags x input decode off/on x Hanatos/Mallett/Arctic. Manual EV0.75, auto exposure and compression off. 44 bounded auto/compression/output controls. All remaining defaults serialized in each capture.
